records.summary: 최근 피해나 군중 제어를 받지 않은 동안 공허 태세가 피해를 줄이고 방해 및 이동 불가 효과에 면역을 부여합니다. 피해를 받거나 해당 효과를 막은 뒤에도 잠시 지속되며, 재사용 대기시간이 있습니다.

sourceEvidence.quote: When he hasn't recently taken damage or been crowd controlled, Malzahar gains massive damage reduction and crowd control immunity, lingering for a short period after taking damage.
Malzahar gains 90% damage reduction and immunity from Disabling and Immobilizing effects
Malzahar gains 90% damage reduction and immunity from Disabling and Immobilizing effects, lingering for 0.25 seconds after taking damage or blocking one of those effects.
lingering for 0.25 seconds after taking damage
lingering for 0.25 seconds after taking damage or blocking one of those effects
This effect has a (30 ~ 12) second Cooldown.

coreUnknownGaps.detail: 요약은 최근 피해나 군중 제어를 받지 않은 동안 효과를 얻는다고 설명하지만, 본문은 피해를 받거나 방해·이동 불가 효과를 막은 뒤 잠시 지속된다고 설명합니다. 활성화와 재활성화의 정확한 시점은 확정할 수 없습니다.

evidence.quote: When he hasn't recently taken damage or been crowd controlled
lingering for 0.25 seconds after taking damage or blocking one of those effects

coreUnknownGaps.detail: 재사용 대기시간이 피해를 받은 경우와 효과를 막은 경우 중 언제 시작되는지 본문에서 특정하지 않습니다.

evidence.quote: This effect has a (30 ~ 12) second Cooldown.

records.summary: 제리의 기본 공격은 스킬로 간주됩니다. 이동하거나 집중 사격을 사용하면 충전되며, 충전 상태에 따라 기본 공격의 피해와 충전 소모가 달라집니다.

sourceEvidence.quote: Zeri's Attacks are treated as Abilities instead of Attacks
can be charged up by moving and casting Burst Fire
Uncharged Attacks consume a small amount of charge, deal ((10 ~ 25) + (3% Ability Power)) magic damage and execute enemies below ((70 ~ 160) + (20% Ability Power)) Health.
A fully charged Attack deals ((75 ~ 160) + (110% Ability Power)) + (1% ~ 11%) max Health magic damage and consumes all charge.

records.summary: 집중 사격은 탄환을 연속 발사해 처음 적중한 적에게 물리 피해를 입힙니다. 기본 공격으로 취급되며, 공격 속도에 따라 재사용 대기시간과 시전 시간이 감소합니다.

sourceEvidence.quote: Zeri fires a burst of 7 rounds that deals (22/26/30/34/38 + (102/104/106/108/110% Attack Damage)) physical damage to the first enemy hit.
This Ability is treated as an Attack. This Ability can crit, apply on-hit effects once per target, and hit anything that an Attack can.
The Cooldown and cast time scale down with Attack Speed (max 1.5 attacks per second).
60% of excess Attack Speed is converted into Attack Damage.

records.summary: 전기 파동은 처음 적중한 적에게 물리 피해를 입히고 둔화시킵니다. 지형에 맞으면 광선으로 확산되어 범위에 효과를 적용하며, 챔피언과 몬스터에게 치명타 피해를 입힙니다.

sourceEvidence.quote: Zeri fires an electric pulse that deals (30/70/110/150/190 + (100% Attack Damage) + (50% Ability Power)) physical damage and Slows the first enemy hit by 30/35/40/45/50% for 2 seconds.

If the pulse hits terrain, it expands into a laser that applies the effects in an area and Critically Strikes champions and monsters for (30/70/110/150/190 + (100% Attack Damage) + (50% Ability Power)) × (0.5 + 50% Critical Strike Damage) physical damage.
This Ability's cast time scales down with Attack Speed.
Empowered damage scales with Critical Strike Damage at 50% effectiveness.

coreUnknownGaps.detail: ‘Empowered damage’가 가리키는 피해 종류나 적용 대상 범위가 툴팁에서 구체적으로 지정되지 않습니다.

evidence.quote: Empowered damage scales with Critical Strike Damage at 50% effectiveness.

records.summary: 스파크 돌진은 짧은 거리를 돌진하며, 접촉한 지형을 뛰어넘으면 돌진 거리가 크게 늘어납니다. 이후 집중 사격은 일정 시간 동안 적을 관통하고, 기본 공격 적중은 재사용 대기시간을 줄입니다.

sourceEvidence.quote: Zeri dashes a short distance and vaults over any terrain she touches, greatly extending the dash range.
For the next 5 seconds, her shots of Burst Fire pierce dealing 80/85/90/95/100% damage to enemies after the first

For the next 5 seconds, her shots of Burst Fire pierce dealing 80/85/90/95/100% damage to enemies after the first and an additional (22/24/26/28/30 + (20% Ability Power)) magic damage On-Hit to the first target struck.
and an additional (22/24/26/28/30 + (20% Ability Power)) magic damage On-Hit to the first target struck.
Hitting an enemy with an Attack reduces this Ability's cooldown by 0.5 seconds.
Critical strikes reduce the cooldown by 1.5 seconds instead.
On-hit damage is increased by Zeri's Critical Strike Chance and Critical Strike Damage at 100% effectiveness.
Pierce damage can critically strike but does not apply On-Hit effects.

coreUnknownGaps.detail: 치명타 적중으로 재사용 대기시간이 감소하는 문장에는 기본 공격이라는 제한이 명시되어 있지 않아, 발동 가능한 적중 종류를 확정할 수 없습니다.

evidence.quote: Critical strikes reduce the cooldown by 1.5 seconds instead.

records.summary: 번개 방출은 주변 적에게 마법 피해를 입힙니다. 적 챔피언에게 적중하면 제리가 공격 속도와 이동 속도를 얻으며, 이후 기본 공격 또는 스킬로 적 챔피언을 맞히면 지속시간이 늘고 과충전 중첩이 쌓입니다.

sourceEvidence.quote: Zeri discharges a nova of electricity, dealing (150/250/350 + (110% Ability Power) + (60% bonus Attack Damage)) magic damage to nearby enemies.
If she hits an enemy champion, Zeri gains 30% Attack Speed and 15% Move Speed for 5 seconds.
Hitting an enemy champion with an Attack or Ability extends this ability's duration and adds a stack of Overcharge for 2.5 seconds.
Critical strikes add 2 additional stacks.
Each stack grants 1.5% Move Speed.
During this time, Burst Fire becomes a faster triple shot that chains (40% Attack Damage) physical damage to nearby enemies.
The Attack Speed also increases Zeri's max Attack Speed.
Uncharged Attacks do not stack or refresh this ability.
This ability's duration extension cannot exceed its original duration of 5 seconds.

coreUnknownGaps.detail: 연쇄 번개 피해의 40% 공격력 계수가 기본 공격력인지 추가 공격력인지 툴팁에 명시되지 않아 스탯 종류를 확정하지 않았습니다.

evidence.quote: chains (40% Attack Damage) physical damage to nearby enemies.
